C0317.title: Shanghai's First Verdict in Programmatic Bulk Real-Name Game Account Registration Case
C0317.summary: On February 20, 2025, the Jing'an District Court in Shanghai delivered the city's first verdict in a case involving programmatic bulk real-name registration of game accounts. The defendant, Ma, used automated methods to bypass real-name verification mechanisms, registering game accounts in bulk for illegal profit.
